hints.title: Prefix Maximum and Suffix Minimum
hints.text: Condition for beauty of two requires current element to be strictly greater than maximum of all predecessors and strictly less than minimum of all successors.

hints.title: Precomputing Boundary Extremes
hints.text: Precompute prefix maximum array and suffix minimum array in linear time.

hints.title: Prioritize Beauty Two over Beauty One
hints.text: For index i from one to n minus two, check prefix max and suffix min first for score two, else check adjacent neighbors for score one.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N) three linear passes across array of length N
complexity.space: O(N) auxiliary memory for prefix maximum and suffix minimum arrays
complexity.notes: Precomputation reduces all predecessor and successor checks to O(1).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing prefix max and suffix min per index yields quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Storing boundary arrays trades linear space for linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should precompute boundary extremes and evaluate criteria in order of priority.
